pages.text: Click a loader to open its screen: nine $(l)filter$() slots, a button for loading or unloading, and one for what the filter does: $(l)only these$(), or $(l)all but these$(). To put an item in, click a filter slot holding it, or shift-click it in your inventory: the filter shows a copy. Click a slot empty-handed to clear it.

A filled bucket stands for its fluid, for tank wagons, and a spawn egg for its animal. Items, fluids and animals are filtered separately, and engines' fuel isn't filtered at all.$(br2)So one station can load iron into one train and coal into another, or unload just the logs.
Iron ore, coal and water in the filter.
